Understand terms
Expense ratio
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments.     It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.
Tax
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments.     Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.
Exit load
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.
Stamp duty
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

About Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth
Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Navi Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 04 Dec 2009. Ashutosh Shirwaikar is the Current Fund Manager of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM)
Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Navi Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 04 Dec 2009. Ashutosh Shirwaikar is the Current Fund Manager of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹9,103 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 04 Mar 2026 is ₹26.30.
The Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹100.

The scheme to generate capital appreciation in the long term through equity investments by investing in a diversified portfolio of large cap, mid cap and small cap companies as defined by SEBI from time to time.

FAQs
How to Invest in Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth?
You can easily invest in Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth in a hassle-free manner on Groww. The
        process is extremely simple, quick and completely paperless. Invest in a few minutes with the following steps:
Log on to your Groww account
Search for Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth from the search box
In order to invest, you will have to complete all the KYC formalities which are completely online and paperless
        and take a few minutes to complete
Once you are done with that, you can start investing in Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth as SIP or lumpsum as per your
        investment objective and risk tolerance
What kind of returns does Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth provide?
The Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth has been there from 09 Jul 2018 and the average annual returns provided by this fund is 16.71% since its inception.
How much expense ratio is charged by Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth?
The term
Expense Ratio
used for Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth or any other mutual fund is the annual
        charges one needs to pay to the Mutual Fund company for managing your investments in that fund.
The Expense Ratio of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth is 0.56% as of 05 Mar 2026...
What is the AUM of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth?
The AUM, short for
Assets Under Management
of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth is ₹252.74Cr as of 05 Mar 2026.
How to Redeem Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth?
If you want to sell your Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth holdings, go to your holding on the app or
        web and simply click on it. You will get two options - redeem & invest more; click on redeem and enter your
        desired amount or if you wish to redeem the entire holding amount then select the 'redeem all' checkbox.
Can I invest in SIP and Lump Sum of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth?
You can select either
SIP
or
Lumpsum
investment of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth based on
        your investment objective and risk tolerance.
What is the NAV of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth?
The NAV of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth is ₹26.30 as of 04 Mar 2026.
What is the PE and PB ratio of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth?
The
PE ratio
ratio of Navi Flexi Cap Fund Direct Growth is determined by dividing the market price by
        its earnings per share and the
PB ratio
of the same is evaluated by dividing the stock price per share by its book value
        per share (BVPS).
